premise: The wind tries to play tag with everything in the forest, and only when everyone holds still does it settle in the grass.
inspiration: The North Wind and the Sun (Aesop), turned: the wind is a playmate rather than a rival, and stillness, not force, is what calms it.
lesson: Sometimes the way to calm things is to be calm yourself.

en-US.title: The Wind Wants to Play
en-US.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} [curious] Can you feel it? Something is tickling the forest. {canvas:wind 0.6 30s} {sfx:wind-bed} It's the wind, and the wind wants to play tag! {sfx:whoosh} Whoosh! It tags the {duckling:enter} {duckling:face surprised} duckling as he waddles by. He {duckling:live} fluffs up, tucks his head under his wing… then pops out, shakes his feathers and quacks! Whoosh! It tags the {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} butterfly, and {butterfly:spin} she twirls round and round. Whoosh! It tags the {pinecone:enter} pinecone, and off she {pinecone:spin} rolls, and the {acorn:enter} acorn {acorn:hop x3} bounces after her. {all:hop x2} Everyone runs. {all:face surprised} But nobody can catch the wind! [giggles] Then the duckling has an idea. {duckling:face happy} Stand still, he says. {all:face normal} So everyone stands very, very still. The butterfly {butterfly:live hold} folds her wings together and rests. [softly] The wind looks around. Nobody is running. So it lies down in the long grass, curls up… and hums. [whispers] Shh. The butterfly {butterfly:live resume} opens her wings again and flutters, ever so softly. {all:face happy} The wind is having a rest.

es-ES.title: El viento quiere jugar
es-ES.text: {butterfly:float loop 0.3} [curious] ¿Lo notáis? Algo le está haciendo cosquillas al bosque. {canvas:wind 0.6 30s} {sfx:wind-bed} ¡Es el viento, y el viento quiere jugar al pillapilla! {sfx:whoosh} ¡Fiuuu! Pilla al {duckling:enter} {duckling:face surprised} patito, que pasaba anadeando. {duckling:live} Se ahueca, esconde la cabeza bajo el ala… y luego la saca, se sacude las plumas y hace ¡cuac! ¡Fiuuu! Pilla a la {butterfly:enter} {butterfly:face happy} mariposa, y {butterfly:spin} ella da vueltas y vueltas. ¡Fiuuu! Pilla a la {pinecone:enter} piña, que {pinecone:spin} sale rodando, y la {acorn:enter} bellota {acorn:hop x3} va saltando detrás. {all:hop x2} Todos corren. {all:face surprised} ¡Pero nadie puede pillar al viento! [giggles] Entonces el patito tiene una idea. {duckling:face happy} Quietos, dice. {all:face normal} Y todos se quedan muy, muy quietos. La mariposa {butterfly:live hold} junta las alas y descansa. [softly] El viento mira a su alrededor. Nadie corre. Así que se tumba en la hierba alta, se hace un ovillo… y tararea. [whispers] Chis. La mariposa {butterfly:live resume} vuelve a abrir las alas y aletea, muy suavecito. {all:face happy} El viento está descansando.

wind-bed.prompt: a playful gentle breeze rustling through leaves and long grass

whoosh.prompt: a single soft comic whoosh of wind
